name: go-app-98e447c0-blind30-ots
instr:
# go-app-regen

Someone using this toolkit to build and publish a browser front end finds it wrong in many places at once. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. Nothing about the browser, the markup conventions or my own calls changed; work that used to come out right now comes out wrong, and in a few places what used to be produced is refused outright.

Putting a piece of interface together and giving it its appearance goes wrong first. Every property I assign keeps the spaces and newlines that surrounded it rather than being trimmed. Assigning the inline presentation declaration twice on one element runs both declarations together with nothing between them, so I get width:42pxheight:42px, whereas doing the same with style names or with image candidate lists still inserts the separator. Tacking further style names onto a list that already has content glues them on with no space, and doing it to an empty list leaves a space in front of the first one. A verbatim markup snippet that begins with a newline and some indentation reports its opening element kind as empty, while the same snippet with nothing before the angle bracket reports that kind fine. And attaching an element that already has a child into a live tree leaves the child reporting a shallower depth than its parent — zero beneath a parent at one — rather than one deeper.
